maps/CaveSupplyMart.asm:
object_const_def
	const CAVESUPPLYMART_HM_CLERK
	const CAVESUPPLYMART_GEAR_CLERK

CaveSupplyMart_MapScripts:
	def_scene_scripts
	def_callbacks

CaveSupplyMartHMClerk:
	faceplayer
	opentext
	writetext CaveSupplyMartHMIntro
	waitbutton
	pokemart MARTTYPE_STANDARD, MART_CAVE_HMS
	closetext
	end

CaveSupplyMartGearClerk:
	faceplayer
	opentext
	writetext CaveSupplyMartGearIntro
	waitbutton
	pokemart MARTTYPE_STANDARD, MART_CAVE_GEAR
	closetext
	end

CaveSupplyMartHMIntro:
	text "All seven HMs are"
	line "free here!"
	para "HMs are reusable."
	line "One of each is"
	cont "enough!"
	para "You still need the"
	line "right BADGES to"
	cont "use them outside"
	cont "battle."
	done

CaveSupplyMartGearIntro:
	text "Welcome to our"
	line "new cave shop!"
	para "POTIONS and BALLS"
	line "are all free."
	para "Take what you need"
	line "for your journey!"
	done

CaveSupplyMart_MapEvents:
	db 0, 0
	def_warp_events
	warp_event 2, 7, NEW_BARK_CAVE, 2
	warp_event 3, 7, NEW_BARK_CAVE, 2
	def_coord_events
	def_bg_events
	def_object_events
	object_event 3, 1, SPRITE_CLERK, SPRITEMOVEDATA_STANDING_DOWN, 0, 0, -1, -1, PAL_NPC_BLUE, OBJECTTYPE_SCRIPT, 0, CaveSupplyMartHMClerk, -1
	object_event 8, 1, SPRITE_CLERK, SPRITEMOVEDATA_STANDING_DOWN, 0, 0, -1, -1, PAL_NPC_RED, OBJECTTYPE_SCRIPT, 0, CaveSupplyMartGearClerk, -1

MACRO add_tmnum
	DEF \1_TMNUM EQU __tmhm_value__

MACRO add_tm
; Defines three constants:
; - TM_\1: the item id, starting at $bf
; - \1_TMNUM: the learnable TM/HM flag, starting at 1
; - TM##_MOVE: alias for the move id, equal to the value of \1
	const TM_\1
	DEF TM{02d:__tmhm_value__}_MOVE = \1
	add_tmnum \1
ENDM

CaveShopSafeContinue::
	ld a, [wMapGroup]
	cp GROUP_NEW_BARK_CAVE
	ret nz
	ld a, [wMapNumber]
	cp MAP_NEW_BARK_CAVE
	ret nz
	ld a, [wXCoord]
	cp 2
	ret c
	cp 6
	ret nc
	ld a, [wYCoord]
	cp 2
	ret c
	cp 6
	ret nc
	ld a, 3
	ld [wXCoord], a
	ld a, 6
	ld [wYCoord], a
	farcall RefreshPlayerCoords
	ret
ENDSECTION
